name: KyberSwap (Kyber Network)
technique: Frontend supply chain; Privileged account compromise; Phishing
classificationNote: Classified by TypeSafe jev-1.13.0 (confidence 0.92). Replaced keyword guess "social-engineering".
rootCause: KyberSwap's frontend was compromised via a malicious script injected through a stolen Cloudflare API key, causing targeted token approvals and theft of over $265,000 from one user's wallet on September 1, 2022. All affected funds were reimbursed. A compromised Cloudflare Global API key, due to successful phishing of a privileged ex-employee account, allowed an attacker to inject malicious JavaScript into KyberSwap's website. This script manipulated token approval flows and redirected permissions to attacker-controlled addresses.
